definition: II. [ חָנַן ] be loathsome (compare Arabic x. foetorem emisit (puteus); Syriac rancid ); — only וְחַנֹּתִ֫י לִבְנֵי בִטְנִי Job 19:17 and I am loath-some to the sons of my womb (|| זָרָה see II. זור ), so RVm Ew De Di and others (On the tone see De.)
